title: UniversanyCircuits
description: Monifactory universal circuit textures ported to GregTech New Horizons (replaces Dreamcraft's any circuits)
body:
Does what it says on the tin — a "backport" of the Monifactory Universal circuit items to older GregTech versions, as well as three additional textures for the UMV, UXV, and MAX tiers.

Special Credit to [WithersChat](https://www.curseforge.com/members/witherschat/projects) for creating the original ULV-UIV tier textures as part of the [Monifactory](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/monifactory) project.

Thanks to my friend Dragonz/soggy.man for help with putting together the initial pack.

### Before

* With original Dreamcraft Textures:

![Stereotypical, square packaged circuit-board components in grayscale. Each has a tier abbreviation printed on top.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/19b901491d9dcde8494d6d66c2ecb0f92917e3d5.png)

* With GTNHRefreshed's Textures:

![Stereotypical, square packaged circuit-board components, but with copper traces. Each has a blocky, low-res abbreviation of the tier printed on top.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5d20f40940bd0e76a680cf1dd433cc3ebd83cae2.png)

### After
![Colorful, animated "cartridge-style" circuits](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fdf8ee11efd3299855a8ae52b2cdff6fcb6ecd90.png)

## Other Texture Changes:

Given that this is intended for GTNH, I also took the prerogative to use the new textures in the "wrap" items, which can be viewed in the Gallery.
